Sabine Schaller
Jan 13, 2020 #1

Hello community,

Last November, I attended the SF DeFi Hackathon and worked on a project called Hugo + Web Monetization. TLDR: I hacked a Hugo theme to allow for web monetization and exclusive content.

I originally planned to get this feature included into the core Hugo stack but unfortunately, the Hugo community did not think that web monetization was a thing (yet), so they suggested that I write a Hugo theme component instead–which I did!

Hugo Web Monetization Component

I would love for somebody to check it out, find bugs, suggest improvements or additional features.

Thanks a lot!
